purpose: Enforced, deterministic source-quality floors layered alongside the package coverage reporters. These floors bound unsafe TypeScript suppressions and floating Promises in the source bucket. They are behavior-neutral at introduction and block future regressions.
scope: source bucket only — files classified 'source' by the coverage-baseline classifier (**/src/**/*.{ts,mts,cts}); test, generated (dist/build-info), archive, and non-src 'other' files are excluded.
ratchetContract: Floors only ever ratchet downward. The guard requires measured == max: raising max is allowed only when a new suppression is genuinely unavoidable and must carry a one-line justification; removing suppressions requires lowering max in the same PR so the surface cannot silently regrow.

unsafeSuppressions.definition: A suppression that silences a diagnostic without proof it is still needed: @ts-ignore, @ts-nocheck, a bare @ts-expect-error (no inline explanation), or any eslint-disable* directive (dead — the repo ships no ESLint config). @ts-expect-error WITH an inline explanation is the safe form and is intentionally allowed.
unsafeSuppressions.note: Repository-wide unsafe-suppression floor for #1506. Package reporters independently enforce bounded line-coverage floors for selected lifecycle, policy, evidence, provenance, and runner modules.

floatingPromises.definition: A Promise-valued production-source expression statement that is not awaited, returned, assigned, rejection-handled with catch/then, or explicitly marked as reviewed fire-and-forget work with void. Tests, declarations, generated output, archive, and non-src files are excluded.
floatingPromises.note: Type-aware zero-floor for #1506. The checker uses each package TypeScript project so Promise unions and conditional/logical branches cannot bypass the gate; package-CI parity selects only the touched package while the root gate checks the full workspace.
